storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP StripchatVR Downloader makes it easy to record live VR streams from Stripchat directly to your computer.

How it works: Go to any model page on Stripchat VR, click the Start button in the popup or the download button on the player, select your quality, and the extension begins capturing the live stream in real time. Click Stop when you're done, and it saves as a standard MP4 file with VR metadata in the filename.

It handles Stripchat's HLS streaming, CDN encoding (including Mouflon key decoding), and VR camera settings automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. The extension uses the Stripchat API to detect stream availability, model status, and VR configuration.

Key features:
- Real-time live stream capture with start/stop controls
- VR metadata support — stereoPacking, frameFormat, and horizontal angle preserved
- Stripchat API integration for reliable stream detection
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Real-time capture progress with segment counting and elapsed time
- Right-click context menu for quick capture
- VR badge showing stream configuration details
- Dark-themed UI with coral pink accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to Stripchat VR and open a model page while the stream is live
3. Click the Start button in the popup or the player download button
4. Select quality and start capture — click Stop when done — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited captures.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I record a live stream?
faq.answer: Go to any model page on Stripchat VR while the stream is live. Click the Start button in the popup or the download button on the player. Select quality and begin capture. Click Stop when you're done.

faq.question: Does this support VR content?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects VR camera settings (stereoPacking, frameFormat, horizontal angle) and includes them in the filename. A VR badge shows the configuration details in the popup.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available HLS quality levels from the stream — typically multiple resolutions. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first).

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device, media player, or VR headset.

faq.question: Can I download recorded/VOD content too?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension supports both live stream capture and VOD downloads from Stripchat video pages.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited captures.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: What if the model is offline or in a private show?
faq.answer: The extension will show a status message indicating the model is offline or in a private show. You need to wait for the public stream to resume.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Stream processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
